raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / NUOVA BIFAMILIARE A PONTE CREPALDO NEW DEVELOPMENT · SEMI-DETACHED HOUSE Nuova Bifamiliare a Ponte Crepaldo PONTE CREPALDO · ERACLEA · VENEZIA PRICE €345,000 Photos (11) Floor plans (2) 1 / 11 FLOOR AREA 151 m² BEDROOMS 4 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Ponte Crepaldo! Inside a modern semi-detached house, designed to offer comfort, quality, and maximum living independence. The property will be built with an energy class A4 rating and equipped with the most advanced technological solutions to ensure maximum comfort and high energy efficiency, including underfloor heating, heat pump, photovoltaic system of 6 kW, provision for controlled mechanical ventilation in every room, PVC windows with triple glazing, armored entrance door, garage with motorized sectional door and preparation for alarm system. The residence spans two levels for a total area of approximately 151 sqm, including terraces and parking space, as well as a private outdoor area. The interior spaces are designed to provide bright, modern and well-organized environments ideal for the daily life of a family. On the ground floor is the living area characterized by a spacious open space with living room and kitchen; a welcoming and functional environment perfect also for hosting guests. This level is completed by a bathroom with ante-bathroom, a practical storage room and an internal staircase leading to the upper floor. The sleeping area on the first floor features four generously sized bedrooms along with one bathroom and an hallway that ensures comfortable distribution of spaces. Outside, the property offers two terraces perfect for moments of relaxation outdoors as well as private parking space adjacent to it. The location is set within a quiet residential context but well-serviced: Eraclea beach can be reached in about 10 minutes; Jesolo in about 20 minutes while San Donà di Piave enjoys convenient connections. An ideal solution for those seeking tranquility ,comfortand proximityto theseaside without sacrificing service convenience . We look forwardto seeing you at our officesfor information ,plansand availability .
